title: integrate
body:
## integrate

Integrates all point and cell arrays over the input's cells and computes the total length, area or volume, producing a one-point unstructured grid with one integrated value per array. Only cells of the highest dimension present are used (a volume mesh ignores its faces) and vertex cells are not integrated. With divideByVolume the cell-data integrals are divided by the total size, giving size-weighted means. Use it for totals such as mass or force and for mean values; results carry the array units times length, area or volume.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Point-data results are never divided; for a point-field mean divide by the size array yourself or convert to cell data first.
- Integrating a vector gives componentwise integrals, not a flux; compute the normal component with a calculator first.

Native constructor: `IntegrateVariables`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `divideByVolume` | Divide integrated cell-data values by the dataset measure (length, area or volume for the retained cell dimension), producing a mean rather than a total. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "integrate",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
